description: Scrape Dubizzle UAE product listings. Provide search URLs or use keyword/location filters to find listings across motors, real estate, jobs, and more. Independent tool — not affiliated with Dubizzle.

ignore_url_failures.description: Continue running the scraper even if some URLs fail after max retries.
ignore_url_failures.title: Ignore URL Failures

keyword.description: Keyword to search for (e.g., 'Toyota', 'laptop', 'apartment'). Used only when no URLs are provided.
keyword.sectionDescription: Use keyword + location to search. Ignored when URLs are provided.
keyword.title: Search Keyword

max_items_per_url.description: Maximum number of items to scrape per URL or search query.
max_items_per_url.title: Max Items Per URL/Search

max_retries_per_url.description: Maximum retry attempts for each URL if it fails.
max_retries_per_url.title: Max Retries Per URL

page.description: Page number to start scraping from (1-based).
page.title: Starting Page

urls.description:
Dubizzle product list page URLs to scrape. When provided, keyword/location/sort filters are ignored.

Examples:
- https://dubai.dubizzle.com/motors/used-cars/
- https://abudhabi.dubizzle.com/property-for-rent/residential/
- https://sharjah.dubizzle.com/electronics/
urls.sectionDescription: Enter one or more Dubizzle search page URLs. These take priority over keyword/location filters.
urls.title: Search URLs

title: Dubizzle Listings Scraper (Unofficial)
